title: Paul McCartney live: O2 Arena, London | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the O2 Arena in London, England, on 16 December 2018.

Heading to Paul’s #FreshenUpTour at @TheO2 tomorrow? 'Get On The Right Thing' and come see the 'Wings 1971-73' mural in Shoreditch. Keep an eye out for ? the design on stage… pic.twitter.com/WJu3vl6kK8

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) December 15, 2018

It was the 18th show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 15,651 fans.

During the encore performance of ‘Get Back’, McCartney was joined onstage by Ringo Starr and The Rolling Stones’ Ronnie Wood.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by Paul McCartney (@paulmccartney)

There’s nothing like performing in front of your home crowd, especially when it’s been a while. I can’t wait to finish the year on such a high by partying in Liverpool, Glasgow and London. We’ve freshened up the show since our last time round and we are excited to get to play some of our new songs along side some of the favourites.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney previously performed at the O2 Arena on 22 December 2009 for the Good Evening Europe Tour; 5 December 2011 for the On The Run Tour; and 23 and 24 May 2015 for the Out There Tour. He returned there on 18 and 19 December 2024 for the Got Back Tour
